{{Top}}
'''Ground assault vehicles''' or '''GAVs''' was the designation given to a multitude of armored ground vehicles.

[[File:Juggernaut_Imperial_Sourcebook_II.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]] was a GAV in service to the Galactic Empire.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Balawai militia]] on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] used modified [[steamcrawler]]s that were equipped with high-explosive chemical [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]], and side-mounted high-velocity [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]].<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the term received usage as the all-encompassing definition for terrestrial war machines ranging from [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] to [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], including subcategories such as [[Light assault vehicle|Light Assault Vehicles]], [[Heavy assault vehicle|Heavy Assault Vehicles]], [[Surface Assault Vehicle]]s, [[Repulsorlift Assault Vehicle]]s, and walker-type.<ref name="J9">{{JournalCite|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}}</ref><ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
